lines.zh: 我迈着短腿，在针叶间穿行
lines.en: I waddle through the juniper needles.

lines.zh: 翅膀小得可怜，只用来看
lines.en: My wings are pitifully small, only for show.
My plump body rocks side to side.

lines.zh: 刺柏的枝条刮过我的背
lines.en: Juniper branches rake my back.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但一步不少
lines.en: I'm slow, but I never cut a step short.
Pine needles give softly underfoot.
I push a branch aside with my beak.
A few of my kind trail behind me.
My tail bobs up and down.
This juniper wood is my home.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根小枝，吓了一跳
lines.en: I snap a twig and startle myself.
I step around a tree's roots.

lines.zh: 走路的时候，我头一点一点
lines.en: As I walk my head nods.
I haul my round body along.
In the tree shade I can't see the path well.

lines.zh: 我停在树荫边上，喘口气
lines.en: I stop at the shade's edge to breathe.
I tuck my head into my feathers.
Juniper has a sharp smell.
I daze, eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 我的同类在我旁边刨土
lines.en: My kin scratch at the soil nearby.
Wind through needles makes a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我扑了扑短翅膀，灰乱飞。
lines.en: I flap my stubby wings and dust flies.
This wood is far too quiet.

lines.zh: 我把喙在树干上磨了磨
lines.en: I rub my beak on a trunk.
I tilt my head. I hear nothing.
I squat to warm my belly.
Something moves under the bark.
I just stand. Nothing else to do.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛颜色不太起眼
lines.en: My feathers aren't much to look at.
Someone is moving in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见一个高的东西
lines.en: I look up at something very tall.

lines.zh: 你站在刺柏后面，我看见了
lines.en: You're behind the juniper. I see you.
I don't mean to run.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张了一下，又合上
lines.en: My wings open once, then close.

lines.zh: 你身后还有别的影子吗
lines.en: Are there more shadows behind you?
I tilt my head and stare a long while.

lines.zh: 你不像这林子里的东西
lines.en: You don't belong in this wood.
I shuffle one small step forward.
My kin have all stopped.
You reach out; I take half a step back.
I squawk and my feathers puff.
I flop down, then scramble up.
I stumble behind a tree.
A feather drifts down.
That knocked the wind out of me.
My kin scatter in all directions.
I shake myself, unsteady.
My beak is numb from the knock.
I don't want to keep fighting.
Walk away and I'll stay put.

lines.zh: 你手里是什么，我没见过
lines.en: What's that in your hand? I've not seen it.
I come near only to see it clearly.

lines.zh: 这东西在刺柏林里没有
lines.en: There's nothing like that in this wood.
I tilt my head one way, then the other.
Only if you put it down will I come.

lines.zh: 我的同类在后面看着我
lines.en: My kin are watching from behind me.
I stretch my neck out very long.
That smell is entirely unknown to me.
Step back and I'll try it.
So little. Who is that for?
You bump me and I nearly sit down.

lines.zh: 我的身子软，撞起来不疼
lines.en: I'm soft. Bumping me doesn't hurt.
I stagger two steps and hold.
A patch of my feathers is crushed.
I go around you to avoid touching again.

lines.zh: 同类被我撞得叫了一声
lines.en: I bump my kin and one squawks.
That left me a little dizzy.
I retreat to the tree roots.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的时候，地都在抖。
lines.en: The ground shakes when you lift a foot.
I shift half a step and go back to dazing.
Our flock presses close together.
You're from this juniper wood too, aren't you?

lines.zh: 我把最暖的位置让给你
lines.en: I give you the warmest spot.
We walk at the same rhythm.
There are quite a few of us in this wood.
You needn't fly, and I can't.
Come close and we'll rub beaks.
At night the needles block the wind.
We'll walk slowly. No hurry.
One more in the flock is fine by me.
I peck it up with my beak.

lines.zh: 这东西在针叶里很显眼
lines.en: It stands out among the needles.
I carry it two steps and drop it.

lines.zh: 我的嘴不太适合拿东西
lines.en: My beak isn't made for holding things.
My kin crowd in to look.
Yours? I pecked it twice.
I scrape it under the fallen needles.
Too hard. I can't bite it.
I'm too plump to run fast.
In a blink my kin snatched it.
I have no fangs, only a beak.

lines.zh: 你走近，我们一群都会叫
lines.en: Come near and the whole flock calls.
I back into the thicket.
This juniper is too dense to run in.
My kin have already scattered.
I can't fly. Only run.
You block the light; I'll peck you.
I spread my small wings. Useless.
I can't win this.
Still, I'll hold out a moment.
Can you hear my call?
That's me telling the flock to flee.
Don't lift your foot; I'll hop aside.
You take a step; I take one back.
The dense wood is right behind me.
I count how many feet you have.
Your hand hasn't come down.
My kin have pushed into the needles.
This fat body can't outrun you.
But I know this wood better than you.
Closer and I'll squeeze under the roots.
Then let's take our time with this.
The twigs you snap will give you away.
I can hear every step you take.
This is as far as it goes. Stop following.
I peck your boot once.
That couldn't even break skin.
I ram you with my whole body.
You step back and I slip away.
I flap my short wings and jump.
That jump barely clears my own waist.

lines.zh: 我的喙磕在你的护腿上
lines.en: My beak knocks against your greave.
My kin call out behind me.
You shove me and I roll half a turn.
I get up and charge again.
Honestly, I'd rather run.
But I can't outrun you.

lines.zh: 我跟着一小群落在刺柏林
lines.en: I come down with a small flock.

lines.zh: 针叶下面多了几个圆影子
lines.en: Round shapes appear under the needles.
Several of us arrive at once.
I shake the pine needles off.
Plenty of ground in this wood.

lines.zh: 我落地的样子不太好看
lines.en: My landing isn't graceful.
My kin are already spreading out.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀只能扑腾两下
lines.en: My wings manage two flaps at most.
Colder here than I expected.
I call out once by way of greeting.
The juniper smell settles me.
I poke my head out in the cypress wood.
We've claimed this wood.

lines.zh: 地上的针叶软，落着舒服
lines.en: The needles are soft to land on.
Singed feathers smell awful.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔晕了
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land dazed.

lines.zh: 水一下淹过我，翅膀没用
lines.en: Water closes over me; my wings are useless.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow sinks into me. It hurts.

lines.zh: 这光让我的羽毛立起来
lines.en: That light makes my feathers stand up.
So hungry I stop after two steps.
I bury my head in my wings.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我直往下掉
lines.en: No ground below. I just keep dropping.
